title: 40 Common Misconceptions You Still Believe
description:
Think you know the truth about the world? Think again. In this video from Pale Blue Thoughts, we bust 40 of the most common misconceptions that people still believe — from science myths to history blunders and religious claims.

Did you know?

Goldfish don’t have a 3-second memory — they can remember for months.

Bats aren’t blind — many species have excellent eyesight.

The Great Wall of China isn’t visible from space without magnification.

Einstein never failed math in school — he mastered calculus before 15.

Buddha wasn’t fat — that’s actually Budai, a Chinese folk hero.

Julius Caesar wasn’t born by C-section.

The Quran never mentions “72 virgins” — that comes from a later hadith.

The forbidden fruit in Genesis wasn’t called an apple.

Detox diets don’t work — your liver and kidneys detox you.

Evolution doesn’t claim humans came from chimpanzees.

Birds are living dinosaurs.

Atheists don’t claim to “prove God doesn’t exist”; they just reject the claim without evidence.

From microwaves and MSG to hair myths, vitamin C and colds, and the myth of ‘alpha wolves’, this episode is a rapid-fire myth-busting ride through science, history, health, and religion.

👉 If you’ve searched for common misconceptions, science myths debunked, Einstein failed math, Great Wall visible from space, evolution myths, detox diet scam, 72 virgins Quran, goldfish memory, bats blind myth, atheism misconceptions — this video clears the fog and gives you the facts.
